_comment: Sprint 10 WP3 — config-driven drift event bridge. event_types map each event to signed trait weights (± [-1,1], interpreted against _BASE_DRIFT_COEFFICIENT × intensity). rules are evaluated in order; first match fires. Fields in rule.when: action (str), topic (str), engagement_kind (str), sentiment_gte/sentiment_lt (float), virality_gte/virality_lt (float), trait_gte/trait_lt ({trait:threshold}), topic_in (list[str]). Sprint 16 added regime_consolidation, diplomatic_stalemate, sanctions_pressure event_types and 6 corresponding fallback rules (positioned after positive_social_fallback so legacy first-match behavior is unchanged; weighted sampling picks them up via category drift_event_weights).

leadership_act._doc: Assertive pro-social post in politics/culture; reinforces dominance + persuasive confidence, nudges authority_compliance down (agent becomes the authority, not the follower).

group_conformity._doc: Agent engaged with a mainstream / viral post while already high on herd_susceptibility — the act itself reinforces the conforming tendency.

group_dissent._doc: Agent posted against prevailing sentiment — contrarian reinforcement and individualism uptick.

financial_loss._doc: Posting about finance with loss-aversive outlook serves as a mild loss-proxy event (real monetary outcomes are not modelled this sprint).

financial_gain._doc: Risk-taking agent with positive sentiment on finance — serves as mild gain-proxy event.

cultural_experience._doc: Spiritual/cultural engagement widens openness and bolsters tradition_vs_progress in the pro-tradition direction (because spiritually-oriented agents mostly anchor traditional frames in the cohort).

regime_consolidation._doc: Sprint 16: Authoritarian power consolidation — passive resignation (authority_compliance ↓ as participation gives way to apathy), agency erosion (social_dominance ↓), hardened minority resistance (contrarian_tendency ↑), desensitization to political suffering (empathy ↓). Models status-quo maintenance dynamics absent from the Sprint 9/10 event pool. Magnitudes scaled 5× over original spec at calibration Tier 2 (2026-05-03) so per-event delta is comparable to existing Sprint 9/10 events (0.10-0.20 vs Sprint 10 0.5-1.0 range).

diplomatic_stalemate._doc: Sprint 16: Stalled negotiations / dragged-out sanctions — uncertainty drives risk aversion (risk_appetite ↓), status-quo frustration accumulates (contrarian_tendency ↑), mild institutional fallback (authority_compliance ↑), powerlessness reduces sense of agency (social_dominance ↓). Models the most common geopolitical outcome: nothing changes. Magnitudes scaled 5× over original spec at calibration Tier 2 (2026-05-03).

sanctions_pressure._doc: Sprint 16: Economic sanctions / trade restrictions / asset freezes — broad economic pain (financial_optimism ↓), uncertainty rises (risk_appetite ↓), rally-around-flag under external pressure (authority_compliance ↑), heightened fear of further loss (loss_aversion ↑). Affects geopolitics primarily, economics secondarily. Magnitudes scaled 5× over original spec at calibration Tier 2 (2026-05-03).
